pairs: David went to the house of Ahimelech.
Why do you glory in malice,
you who are powerful in iniquity?
Tota die injustitiam cogitavit lingua tua;
All day long your tongue thinks up injustice.
Like a sharp razor, you have wrought deceit.
You have loved malice above goodness,
and iniquity more than speaking righteousness.
You have loved all precipitous words,
Propterea Deus destruet te in finem;
God will destroy you in the end.
et emigrabit te de tabernaculo tuo,
et radicem tuam de terra viventium.
and he will remove you from your tabernacle and your root from the land of the living.
and they will laugh over him,
Ecce homo qui non posuit Deum adjutorem suum;
“Behold the man who did not set God as his helper.
sed speravit in multitudine divitiarum suarum,
But he hoped in the multitude of his riches,
and so he prevailed in his emptiness.”
sicut oliva fructifera in domo Dei;
like a fruitful olive tree in the house of God,
have hoped in the mercy of God unto eternity,
in æternum et in sæculum sæculi.
I will confess to you forever,
And I will wait on your name,
quoniam bonum est in conspectu sanctorum tuorum.
for it is good in the sight of your saints.
